2610.12963.title: MotionCoach: Constructing Multimodal Guidance for Video Professional Motion Editing
2610.12963.paper_summary: Video editing models achieve strong performance in modifying appearance, backgrounds, styles, and motions, empowered by large-scale training data. Beyond general scenarios, professional motions are significant in performance, sports, and martial arts. This paper focuses on professional motion editing, which involves fine-grained motion technique and temporal structure. Given professional motion names but lacking detailed descriptions, existing models often fail to generate professional motions, such as incorrectly lifting the front wheel under a Stoppie instruction. To address this challenge, we introduce MotionCoach, a trained multimodal agent that uses multi-turn tools and performs self-verification, producing a grounded prompt and a reference clip as reliable and sufficient multimodal guidance to inject external professional motion knowledge into video editing models. To supply training data, we build a data pipeline to construct trajectories. We cold-start the agent on MotionCoach-SFT-10k and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on MotionCoach-RL-2k with rewards on the motion guidance prompt, the motion outcome video, and the format. For evaluation, we introduce VPMEBench, comprising 314 professional motion editing tasks with fine-grained references and annotations. Extensive experiments show that MotionCoach improves the overall score from 55.1 to 65.6 on Seedance 2.0 and from 51.2 to 64.5 on MiniMax-H3. Learning to construct multimodal guidance enables precise professional motion editing without retraining video editing models.
2610.12963.paper_summary_zh: 視頻編輯模型在修改外觀、背景、風格和動作方面表現出色，這得益於大規模的訓練數據。除了通用場景外，專業動作在表現、運動和武術中具有重要意義。本文專注於專業動作編輯，涉及細緻的動作技術和時間結構。考慮到專業動作名稱但缺乏詳細描述，現有模型往往無法生成專業動作，例如在 Stoppie 指令下錯誤地抬起前輪。為了解決這一挑戰，我們引入了 MotionCoach，一個訓練過的多模態代理，使用多輪工具並進行自我驗證，生成一個基於現實的提示和參考片段，作為可靠且充足的多模態指導，將外部專業動作知識注入視頻編輯模型中。為了提供訓練數據，我們建立了一個數據管道來構建軌跡。我們在 MotionCoach-SFT-10k 上冷啟動代理，並在 MotionCoach-RL-2k 上應用群體相對策略優化（GRPO），獎勵包括動作指導提示、動作結果視頻和格式。為了評估，我們引入了 VPMEBench，包括 314 個專業動作編輯任務，並附有細緻的參考和註釋。廣泛的實驗表明，MotionCoach 將 Seedance 2.0 的整體得分從 55.1 提升至 65.6，將 MiniMax-H3 的得分從 51.2 提升至 64.5。學習構建多模態指導使得精確的專業動作編輯成為可能，而無需重新訓練視頻編輯模型。
